senior-review:ui-race-auditor.instructions: Does the task examine asynchronous UI rendering, layout, event callbacks, programmatic scroll or focus, or synchronization of state shared across UI consumers?

criteria.false: The task has no relevant UI timing or shared-state synchronization concern; backend concurrency, static styling, and pure display computations alone are outside scope.
